raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "expire"
  role subject "the contract with Transilvania Paleti"
  role time "3 of next month"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@q query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "expire"
    role subject "the contract with Transilvania Paleti"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
